decisions.reason: The church-motif music box extends the firm's established seasonal range, and growing industry turnover suggests results near aspiration, so there is little cause for problemistic search, although its electronic component carries somewhat more uncertainty.
A wooden nativity stable is a core, enduring Christmas product that fits the firm's self-made production and loyal retail demand, so it likely meets aspirations and costs little to carry.

A modern incense smoker figurine sits close to the firm's established line and supports its move toward contemporary design, and with the industry growing and slack available there is no shortfall prompting the firm to drop it.
